title: 'The typical advice for startup founders was: "read The Lean Startup" I'd now recommend updating it to "read The Lean Startup and Incorruptible"'
summary: A Goodreads reviewer proposes promoting the book into the standard founder recommendation alongside Eric's first, gives it six stars out of five, adds it to his re-read shelf, and says he hopes it reaches beyond tech to anyone still in the workforce.
blockquote: The typical advice for startup founders was: "read The Lean Startup" I'd now recommend updating it to "read The Lean Startup and Incorruptible". 6 stars from me and added to re-read shelf as well.
